svg.aria-label: Grid of squares, one per hop of 17 staged neural routes, showing source-check result, species and human status
svg.text: Evidence behind each hop of the 17 staged routes
One square per hop, in route order: 90 hops. Fill shows the result of the source check, the letter shows the species the cited
finding comes from, and a mark underneath shows whether the projection is demonstrated in humans. Routes are listed

no mark: 85 carried to humans by homology, not shown directly

svg.text: Staged proposal, not integrated, and not reviewed by a human neuroanatomist. The routes suit tagging what a device touches,
listing canonical pathways and teaching. They are not a basis for claims about what an attack can reach in a person. Hops are not
QIF, TARA and NISS are proposed and unvalidated. Source: _staging/2026-10-refresh/neural-structure-delta.json, routes_v2
